headline: Expanse Loses Another Work to No-Man's-Land
war_summary: Three hours on, the count of works stands unchanged at 436, but the ledger has shifted: the Colonials now hold 308, the Wardens 121, and unclaimed ground has widened to seven. The change came in Weathered Expanse, where a fourth Colonial work passed to no-man's-land, leaving that region at four Colonial, one Warden, and four neutral after one hundred events in twenty-four hours, the heaviest fighting on the board, with thirteen of those events falling inside the last two hours and casualties mounting on both sides. Mooring County remains the costliest ground of the day, 7,181 Colonial and 7,347 Warden fallen, though its tempo has eased to a single event in two hours; MacConmara Barrows and Gravekeeper's Holdfast remain the chief points of contact. Stlican Shelf logged two events in two hours around Briar and Breaker Town, with casualties quickening, and Palantine Berm saw three events in the same window at The Pippeli Stones. Marban Hollow's Checkpoint Bua has gone quiet since late evening, and Callahan's Passage, ten Warden works strong, has recorded nothing in six hours. Thirty-four towns remain the mark for victory.
